posts.summary_en: Budget tiers (KR prices). Light, 85,000 KRW: permanent Ad Removal 7,500, Epic weapon hot deal 1,500, Unique gear 3-piece pack 6,000, monthly reward membership 7,500, Crumble Pass 7,500, special sugarcoating (permanent) membership 55,000. Medium, 217,900 KRW: adds the monthly gacha membership 15,000, the daily dungeon key set 6,000 ×2, the Wind Archer acquisition pack 17,000 and 5★ pack 55,000, the stage pass tiers 1–5 33,900. Full package (whale), 2,646,400 KRW: general, event and weekly packs 1,278,900; memberships 118,000; conditional hot deals 401,800; the Sweet Blessing Lv.1–12 packs 738,500; Crumble, level, stage and promotion passes 109,200 (Crystal-only products excluded). Prices may change; check the shop.

Crystals: take the pickup cookie to 5★ during its window; if stages stall, raise core PvE cookies (Scorpion, Milk, Pomegranate) to 5★; if stages flow, save. Victory medals: Chocosteel and Syrup Metal first (Syrup protects plates from 10 up), then sugar runes and Stellar Points, then pulls. Guild medals: Tea Knight first (not in gacha), then Chocosteel and Syrup (needed in bulk to 20). Mileage (from boxes, and from 10★ cookies drawn again): daily dungeon keys, dough then coin then EXP.

advice.text: Victory medals: Chocosteel, Syrup Metal > runes, Stellar > pulls. Guild medals: Tea Knight > Chocosteel, Syrup. Mileage: dough, coin, EXP keys.

posts.summary_en: Plates amplify sub-stats every 5 levels, so raise the needed plates in steps of 5 (5 → 10 → 15 → 20 → 25; 25 is new in 1.4.002) instead of one plate high. Sword (ATK), bow (accuracy), staff (crit rate) first; bow first if accuracy is short.

advice.text: Steps of 5; sword, bow, staff first.

posts.summary_en: Stellar Link reroll cost by number of locked points: 0 → 10 SP, 1 → 10, 2 → 30, 3 → 60, 4 → 100, 5 → 150, 6 → 220. Locked points stay; the rest are placed without repeats.

Moving from the 55% to the 75% bracket raises real damage by about 36.4% for the same raw damage; a power gain that doesn't cross a bracket line may change nothing, and swapping in high-power cookies can break buffer links. Arena applies cookie level-up and promotion, pet holding effects, collection, gear, plating and sugar runes (in-game guide).

advice.text: Power only pays when it crosses a bracket line.

Global view: packs with permanent buffs are worth most; Permanent Ad Removal first, the Crumble Pass second (extra daily dungeon entries, auto-hunt multipliers, special rewards), about $10 for both; the Special Sugarcoating Membership 'costs a lot for what it gives'; then a TSSR pack (Wind Archer).

quotes.en: the packs that are worth it the most are the packs that grant you permanent buffs or multipliers

posts.summary_en: Global guide: pull pickups with Crystals, pets with tickets; follow the quest chain; level the oven (Excellent+ → Magic+), wear the higher power early; push daily dungeon floors for first-clear rewards (coin dungeon feeds Resolve); Resolve ATK first; Arena → Fame; lab damage path, research speed first among specials; Stellar ≥60% early; guild for help and shop.

advice.text: Resolve: ATK first, then defensive stats.

posts.summary_en: Game 1.4.002. Cookie level 1–100: ATK/DEF/HP +2,652.99% at 100; levels 91–100 cost about 77% of all EXP to 100. Stars: an SSR at 10★ has +136.74% ATK/HP (66 copies), a TSSR +159.37% (55 copies). Plating: main stat +200% at 20 and +315% at 25, sub-stats +30/70/130/200/280% at 5/10/15/20/25. Oven: gear level range oven×3−5 to oven×3; Eternal appears from oven 31 at 0.002% per draw. Collection entries add flat ATK/DEF/HP to roles or elements in steps. Sugar Rune reroll: 20 Rune Crystals unlocked up to 400 with 7 lines locked. Tables in ../07-derived/.
